subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should the dashboard ship cross-provider exact-name token totals without provider-overlap deduplication, or should Scope B remain provider-provenanced until a canonicalization and overlap policy is agreed?
rationale: The linked design discussion identifies canonical identity and double counting as product semantics; tests can prove an implementation but cannot decide what aggregate users should be promised.

options.title: Narrow Scope B to provenance-first totals
options.body: Keep model rows separated or prominently provider-scoped until a canonical identity and overlap policy is specified.

options.title: Accept exact-name aggregation
options.body: Ship the existing exact normalized-name aggregation with explicit non-deduplication wording as the accepted product contract.

options.title: Pause Scope B
options.body: Defer the card until maintainers define canonicalization and double-counting behavior across providers.

recommendation.title: Narrow Scope B to provenance-first totals
recommendation.body: Keep model rows separated or prominently provider-scoped until a canonical identity and overlap policy is specified.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked feature discussion asks maintainers to decide the aggregation contract, and repository ownership is the only available routing signal after sandboxed history inspection failed.
